# Tree-sitter JSON test grammar

Generated parser and parser header from [tree-sitter-json v0.24.8](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-json/tree/v0.24.8), commit `ee35a6ebefcef0c5c416c0d1ccec7370cfca5a24`, under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

Used only by optional backend tests, the editor demo and their documentation preview. This grammar is not linked into or installed with the CUI library; applications supply their own grammars and highlight queries.
